label: Clay Diorama

traits.medium: hand-formed colored-clay miniature reinterpretation of an architectural scene
traits.texture: rounded clay edges, tiny fingerprints and soft handmade surface imperfections
traits.composition: preserve the upward view and diagonal facade; model windows, railing and cloud as simple clay forms
traits.lighting: soft directional daylight with shallow miniature shadows

review_checks: windows and railing retain their rhythm
lighting supports a coherent miniature scene
limitations: Raster visualization only; no 3D model, mesh, construction plan or physically accurate material is supplied.
Palette and fine geometry are prompt guidance and require visual review across a series.
